summary: Extended Data Table 1 in the October 2019 bioRxiv supplement reports numerical results for 29 selected VMHvl genes after estradiol benzoate versus vehicle. All 29 agree in direction with registered edgeR-QL effects (Pearson 0.9310, Spearman 0.9138), and 16 of the 29 author discoveries meet registered FDR < 0.05. This reference falls below the 30-pair minimum for author-concordance-v2.

manualReview.summary: All 29 genes in the preprint’s selected RNA-seq table agree in direction with the registered VMHvl result.
manualReview.note: The October 10, 2019 preprint supplement reports log2 fold changes and adjusted P values in three overlapping groups. The 43 printed rows yield 29 distinct genes, all matched by exact symbol. Registered edgeR-QL and author DESeq2 agree on all 17 increases and 12 decreases. Sixteen meet FDR < 0.05 in both analyses. The published Figure 1d also supports the positive direction of all four labeled genes, including Pgr and Greb1 outside the numerical table. GEO and the registered sample sheet agree on the seven mice and their treatment assignments.
reviewFlags: The selected numerical reference contains 29 pairs. Author-concordance-v2 requires at least 30.
The public table contains selected discoveries and rounded adjusted P values. Genome-wide author inference, raw P values and the testing universe remain unassessed.
Deposited sample files and registered assignments were checked structurally. The original legacy staging inputs lack a committed checksum manifest.

verificationReview.reason: The preprint’s selected-gene table covers 29 registered effects. All directions agree, with Pearson 0.9310 and Spearman 0.9138. All 29 pass the printed author adjusted-P threshold of 0.05, and 16 pass registered BH FDR < 0.05. The 29 pairs fall below the policy minimum. The complete author result and its raw P values remain unavailable.
verificationReview.nextStep: For a genome-wide review, obtain the original GSE181204 DESeq2 results for EB relative to vehicle, including every tested gene, log2 fold change, raw and adjusted P values with missing tests retained, the design and contrast, and filtering and coefficient-shrinkage settings.

comparabilityReview.basis: Compare the registered vmhvl edgeR-QL output with every numerical EB versus vehicle row in the preprint’s Extended Data Table 1. Check the four labeled published volcano directions separately.
comparabilityReview.reference: Krause et al., bioRxiv 10.1101/794792v2 (October 10, 2019), supplement page 7, Extended Data Table 1. Later preprint versions give the same table number to anatomical abbreviations. Nature Figure 1d provides the separate labeled-direction check.

cohort.note: Preprint and manuscript RNA-seq methods describe microdissected VMHvl from four EB-treated and three vehicle-treated ovariectomized females. GEO identifies one mouse per replicate. GSM5492402–GSM5492408 reconcile to all seven samples in the registered sheet and fit.

contrast.note: The GEO treatment is 1 µg estradiol benzoate or vehicle, with tissue collected four hours later. Positive author effects denote higher expression after EB, supported by the Mc4r result and the vehicle-to-EB figure panels. The registered coefficient is groupcase with vehicle as baseline. Orientation sign is +1.

features.note: All 29 unique printed mouse symbols join exactly once to the registered table. Across the three groups, 14 repeated rows have identical effect and adjusted P values. No aliases or ambiguous assignments were used. The full author testing universe is unknown.

effects.note: Both analyses report log2 fold changes for EB relative to vehicle. All 29 nonzero signs agree. Pearson is 0.9310 and Spearman is 0.9138. The median absolute difference is 0.1122 log2 units, with a maximum of 1.6163 for Npy4r. The paired RMS effect ratio (registered/author) is 1.4886. These are comparisons against the five-decimal printed coefficients.

inference.note: The authors used DESeq2 v1.14.1, and the preprint specifies BH-adjusted P < 0.05. The registered analysis used TMM and an edgeR quasi-likelihood group coefficient. Adjusted P is available to five decimals for all 29 selected genes, including eight displayed as 0.00000. All 29 are author discoveries, 16 also pass registered BH FDR < 0.05, and 13 do not. All 29 have registered nominal P < 0.05. Exact author raw P, model settings and genome-wide inference are unassessed.

coverage.note: The numerical reference covers 29/29 selected genes and 29/18,387 registered genes. Of 157 registered FDR calls, 141 fall outside the numerical table and lack a table-based author assessment. The preprint reports 287 discoveries, without a complete gene-level list in the reviewed sources. The figure-only Pgr and Greb1 directions do not add numerical pairs.

comparabilityReview.criteria: Use every printed Table 1 row. Collapse only exact repeat measurements of the same symbol. Join case-sensitively and preserve the published orientation and precision. Compare paired effects, nonzero directions and adjusted P < 0.05 on shared genes. Apply the v2 minimum of 30 pairs and 90% selected-reference coverage, with the correlation or nonzero-direction route. Treat unlisted genes and missing author statistics as unassessed.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: The selected reference shows agreement on direction for every gene and different FDR calls for 13. Its 29 numerical pairs cannot satisfy author-concordance-v2 or support full verification.

additionalComparisonSpec.authorMethod: DESeq2 v1.14.1. Effects and BH-adjusted P values printed to five decimal places in the October 2019 supplement.
additionalComparisonSpec.orientation: Estradiol benzoate minus vehicle in ovariectomized female VMHvl, unchanged from the author reference.
additionalComparisonSpec.note: All 29 unique genes in the three printed Table 1 groups are included. All 29 agree in direction and 16 pass registered FDR < 0.05. Printed 0.00000 values retain the authors’ precision and serve only to establish the call. Raw author P is unassessed. The numerical comparison falls below the 30-pair v2 minimum. Figure-only signs are excluded from the spec.
